rules: FF high-impact AUD / NZD releases 21:45-07:00 UTC (JPY excluded: BoJ minute not known in advance). Direction = the released currency's own pair (AUDUSD / NZDUSD) from the close of the minute before the release to the open of release + 2 min: currency stronger -> BUY NAS100, weaker -> SELL, unchanged -> no trade (no actual needed). Entry NAS100 at market at the open of release + 2 min (skip if no quote within 2 min). Stop 2 x ATR(24 H1 bars before the release), no target, exit 6 h after entry (Friday 20:00 UTC latest), one position at a time, 10% risk.
